title: ONI Companion Link: Graystroke SDF atlas table (v1.2)
description: Written by the mod once per game build to <ONI user folder>/companion/fonts/<build>/graystroke.json beside the atlas texture graystroke.png (a signed-distance field, as the game's TextMeshPro atlas has it). Read from the user's own game at run time and never shipped. The core serves both through GET /fonts. Pixel coordinates have their origin at the TOP-LEFT of the atlas (the mod flips TextMeshPro's bottom-left rects); all metrics are in atlas pixels at pointSize. A front end draws a glyph by sampling `x,y,w,h`, smoothing the distance with `spread`, scaling by size/pointSize, and uses a fallback font for a character with no glyph.

name.description: The game's asset name of the font.

padding.description: SDF padding around each glyph, atlas pixels.

spread.description: Distance range in atlas pixels that maps 0..1 in the texture (TextMeshPro gradient scale).

pointSize.description: Size the atlas was generated at.

bearingX.description: Pen to rect left. x, y, w, h and the bearings describe the tight glyph; the front end adds `padding` around it when sampling.

bearingY.description: Baseline to rect top, positive up.
